title: 李青·听一阵风铃
description: 红布蒙眼的李青穿完整武僧衣，坐在廊下听风铃，双手放松搭在膝上。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Lee Sin is an adult Ionian martial artist with a shaved head, long tied hair detail, a red cloth blindfold, and a calm strong face. Preserve his red wraps, martial trousers, and bare-hand identity, adding a fully covering simple red-brown monk's tunic over the torso. His wrists and ankles are neatly wrapped, and the pose remains restful rather than a fighting demonstration.
art_direction.scene: He sits comfortably on a low veranda bench with both feet supported and hands resting open on his knees, listening toward a small hanging wind chime. One plain tea bowl and a bamboo plant provide gentle context. Keep the blindfold secure, shoulders loose, and the scene accessible and peaceful, without airborne kicks or dramatic energy effects.
art_direction.palette: warm red, clay brown, bamboo green, cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
